Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物，常常一吃就死。但是不知道为什么，没有办法。所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物，告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物：古代的时候，人们
- 所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
- 告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险：是安全的，是危险的
- 发现有的植物对身体非常好，特别是茶，让肚子感觉又暖和又清楚：add他in the beginning; delete 感觉，又暖和又舒服

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代时候：在古代，Use the established time expression for a historical setting; the original combines two overlapping time expressions. [rule: time_expression]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 人：人们，This refers to a concrete group of people in the story, so use the plural human-group noun. [teacher rule: ren_renmen]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 他们能吃什么植物：什么植物能吃，After the people have been named, the repeated subject is unnecessary in this embedded question. [rule: redundancy_delete]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 告诉人：告诉人们，The listener is a concrete group of people, so use the plural human-group noun. [teacher rule: ren_renmen]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 什么植物是安全什么是危险：什么植物是安全的，什么植物是危险的，When these adjectives follow 是 to describe which plants have each quality, they need 的. [rule: none]
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农：一个叫神农的人，This is the character’s first mention, so introduce him with his name and a full noun phrase rather than using only a name. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
7. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 出去试一试很多种植物：出去试了很多种植物，This is a completed testing action in a past narrative, so use 了 after 试; the repeated-verb form suggests only a brief trial and does not fit testing many kinds. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
8. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 告诉：告诉了，The telling is presented as a completed event after the testing, so it takes 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
9. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 但是不知道为什么，没有办法：因为不知道为什么，所以没有办法，The second idea gives the cause of having no solution, not a contrast. [rule: none]

items.reason: “古代时候” needs a proper time expression such as “在古代” or “古代的时候.”
This refers to the concrete people in the story, so the teacher's rule requires “人们.”
“他们能吃什么植物” is an acceptable embedded question and the pronoun is not an error here.
“人” refers to a concrete group here, so it should be “人们” under the teacher's rule.
Predicative “安全” and “危险” need 的 in this construction: “是安全的，是危险的.”
神农 is first introduced here, so the teacher requires a brief full introduction of the character.
Testing many kinds of plants is a completed past action, and “试了很多种植物” correctly expresses that.
The final action in this past sequence should take 了, although the item only shows the isolated verb.
The original use of “但是” is understandable and is not a required connector error, though the proposed causal version is grammatical.
